headword: {食器洗|しょっきあら}い{機|き}

definitions.explanation: An appliance that automatically washes dishes, utensils, and cookware.

examples.japanese: {食器洗|しょっきあら}い{機|き}に{食器|しょっき}を{入|い}れる。
{新|あたら}しい{食器洗|しょっきあら}い{機|き}を{買|か}った。
この{鍋|なべ}は{食器洗|しょっきあら}い{機|き}{対応|たいおう}ですか。

notes:
{食器洗|しょっきあら}い{機|き} is often abbreviated to {食洗機|しょくせんき} in everyday speech.

ALTERNATIVE NAMES:
- {食洗機|しょくせんき} (abbreviation, very common)
- {皿洗|さらあら}い{機|き} (less common)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食器洗|しょっきあら}い{機|き}{対応|たいおう} (dishwasher-safe)
- {食器洗|しょっきあら}い{機|き}を{回|まわ}す (to run the dishwasher)
- ビルトインの{食器洗|しょっきあら}い{機|き} (built-in dishwasher)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Dishwashers are becoming more common in Japanese households but are still less prevalent than in Western countries. Many Japanese kitchens are small, so compact models or sink-mounted types are popular.
